en.name: Harissa
en.summary: Harissa is a North African paste of dried chillies, garlic and spices, sold in tubes, tins and jars. Unopened it keeps about 2 years in a cool dark cupboard. Once opened, refrigerate it and reckon on about 1–2 months; homemade harissa, which has no added acid, is a fresh product and lasts only days.
en.pantry: Unopened tubes and tins keep cool and dark to the printed date, about 2 years from purchase — a figure borrowed from Thai red curry paste, the closest comparable product with a published number. Keep them away from the hob and out of the sun. A tube is the most forgiving format on the shelf because no air gets back in; a tin, once opened, is the least, and its contents should be moved into a jar straight away.
en.fridge: Refrigerate once opened at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and reckon on about 1–2 months. That figure is our widening of the published curry-paste window rather than an agency number, on the grounds that commercial harissa is acidified with vinegar and heavily salted where a fresh curry paste is not; if the jar's own label gives a shorter figure, follow the label. In a jar, level the surface and pour a film of olive oil over it — that keeps the top from drying and darkening, and it is the traditional method. Use a clean dry spoon every time. Homemade harissa is a fresh chilli-and-garlic purée with no added acid: keep it refrigerated, under oil, and use it within a week.
en.freezer: Harissa freezes well and no source gives a limit, so treat several months as a fair ceiling and label the bag with the date. The practical method is to drop teaspoon blobs onto a lined tray, freeze them solid at −18 °C (0 °F), then bag the blobs so you can take out exactly one spoonful. This is also the right answer for a homemade batch you cannot finish quickly.
en.thawing: Thaw a frozen blob in the fridge, or drop it straight into a hot pan or a stew where it will melt. Do not leave a batch thawing on the counter.
spoilage: Fuzzy mould on the surface or around the rim
A fermented, yeasty or alcoholic smell
A bulging tube or tin, or fizzing when the jar is opened
The paste dried to a dark crust with oil separated and smelling rancid
tips: Move the contents of an opened tin into a clean jar immediately.
Pour a film of olive oil over the levelled surface after each use.
Freeze in teaspoon blobs; most recipes want only a spoonful.
Treat homemade harissa as a fresh product, not a preserve.

faq.q: Does harissa need to be refrigerated after opening?
faq.a: Yes. Refrigerate at 4 °C or below and reckon on about 1–2 months, or follow the jar's own label if it is shorter.

faq.q: How long does unopened harissa last?
faq.a: About 2 years in a cool dark cupboard, to the printed date. That figure is borrowed from Thai red curry paste.
Yes — teaspoon blobs frozen on a tray and then bagged work very well. No source gives a limit, so treat several months as the ceiling.

faq.q: How long does homemade harissa keep?
faq.a: Only days. It is a fresh chilli-and-garlic purée with no added acid, so keep it refrigerated under oil and use it within a week.

zh.name: 北非辣醬
zh.summary: Harissa 是北非的辣椒醬，用乾辣椒、蒜和香料做成，有軟管、鐵罐和玻璃罐等包裝。未開封放陰涼避光的櫥櫃大約 2 年。開封後請冷藏，大約以 1～2 個月為準；自製的沒有額外加酸，屬於新鮮食品，只能放幾天。
zh.pantry: 未開封的軟管和鐵罐放在陰涼避光處，到標示日期為止，從購買日起算大約 2 年——這個數字借自泰式紅咖哩醬，那是最接近且有公布數字的產品。請遠離爐火、避免日曬。軟管是架上最耐放的包裝，因為空氣進不去；鐵罐開封後則最不耐，內容物應該立刻移到玻璃罐。
zh.fridge: 開封後請放 4 °C 以下冷藏，大約以 1～2 個月為準。這個數字是我們把已發表的咖哩醬窗口往上放寬的判斷，不是機構數字，理由是市售 harissa 有用醋酸化、鹽分也高，而新鮮咖哩醬沒有；如果罐上標示更短，請以標示為準。裝在玻璃罐時，把表面抹平、淋一層橄欖油蓋住——這能防止表層乾掉變黑，也是傳統做法。每次都用乾淨乾燥的湯匙。自製的 harissa 是沒有加酸的新鮮辣椒蒜泥：請冷藏、用油蓋住，並在一週內用完。
zh.freezer: Harissa 很適合冷凍，而且沒有來源給出期限，所以請把數個月當成合理的上限，並在袋上標日期。實際做法是用小匙挖成一球球放在鋪紙的盤子上，在 −18 °C 凍硬後再裝袋，這樣每次剛好取一匙。自製、短期內吃不完的那一批，也該這樣處理。
zh.thawing: 冷凍的辣醬球請放冷藏解凍，或直接丟進熱鍋或燉鍋裡化開。不要把一整批放在室溫退冰。
spoilage: 醬面或瓶口周圍長出毛狀的霉
聞起來有發酵味、酵母味或酒味
軟管或鐵罐鼓起，或開罐時冒氣
醬乾成深色硬殼、油分離出來並帶油耗味
tips: 鐵罐一開就把內容物移到乾淨的玻璃罐。
每次用完把表面抹平，再淋一層橄欖油蓋住。
用小匙分成一球球冷凍；多數食譜只需要一匙。
自製的請當成新鮮食品，不是保存品。

faq.a: 要。放 4 °C 以下冷藏，大約以 1～2 個月為準；罐上標示更短的話以標示為準。

faq.q: 未開封的 harissa 可以放多久？
faq.a: 陰涼避光的櫥櫃大約 2 年，到標示日期為止。這個數字借自泰式紅咖哩醬。
可以——挖成小球凍硬後裝袋非常好用。沒有來源給期限，請把數個月當成上限。

faq.q: 自製 harissa 可以放多久？
faq.a: 只有幾天。它是沒有加酸的新鮮辣椒蒜泥，請冷藏、用油蓋住，並在一週內用完。
